tasks.request: no-swallowed-errors: block empty catch/except handlers across languages
tasks.summary: New Tier 0 rule no-swallowed-errors. Per the user's choice it applies to newly added lines only, through NEW_CODE_ONLY_RULES and retain_new_code_findings in anvil check and both hook gates; when added lines are unknown every finding is kept.
